glsl_mat_basic_template: Minimal GLSL MAT vertex/pixel pair using TDWorldToProj, TDDeform, TDPos, TDAttrib_* and TDOutputSwizzle

glsl_advanced_pop_template: Minimal GLSL Advanced POP compute shader writing point output attributes

templates.summary: A safe starting pixel shader for a GLSL TOP. Assign this DAT to the GLSL TOP Pixel Shader parameter (`pixeldat`).
required_setup: Use GLSL 4.60 when available.
Set GLSL TOP mode to Vertex/Pixel Shader.
Attach an Info DAT or inspect shader errors before judging black output.
gotchas: Do not add a #version line; TouchDesigner inserts the version.
For pixel shader outputs, pass color through TDOutputSwizzle for cross-platform channel correctness.
If input TOPs are sampled, use the sTD*Inputs arrays and matching TDTexInfo uniforms instead of hand-declared samplers.

templates.summary: A safe starting compute shader for a GLSL TOP output texture. Assign this DAT to the GLSL TOP Compute Shader parameter (`computedat`).
required_setup: Set GLSL TOP mode to Compute Shader.
Use GLSL 4.60 when available.
Set compute dispatch/workgroup parameters so gl_GlobalInvocationID covers the intended output resolution.
gotchas: Do not declare output image uniforms yourself; TouchDesigner defines them for compute shaders.
Use TDImageStoreOutput()/TDImageLoadOutput() instead of direct imageStore()/imageLoad() so sRGB and output swizzle handling stays TouchDesigner-safe.
Do not wrap compute output colors with TDOutputSwizzle because TDImageStoreOutput() handles that internally.
For 3D Texture or 2D Texture Array outputs, include gl_GlobalInvocationID.z in coord and dispatch enough Z threads to cover the texture depth.

templates.summary: A GLSL TOP pixel shader for choosing from 2D input sampler arrays at runtime and sampling neighboring pixels.
required_setup: Attach at least one 2D input TOP.
Use GLSL 4.60 so nonuniformEXT is available for non-uniform sampler indexing.
Use GLSL Multi TOP when the shader needs a large or changing number of inputs.
gotchas: Use nonuniformEXT() when sampler array indices depend on per-pixel shader execution.
Use uTD2DInfos[index].res for pixel-size offsets; textureOffset() is convenient but limited to nearby offsets.
Guard production shaders for zero inputs before sampling, or require at least one input in the network plan.

templates.summary: A GLSL TOP vertex/pixel pair for custom UV varyings and multiple color-buffer outputs.
required_setup: Increase GLSL TOP # of Color Buffers when writing locations beyond 0.
Use Render Select TOP to view color buffers beyond the first output connector.
Keep the vertex shader's gl_Position aligned to the TOP quad.
gotchas: When providing a custom vertex shader, vUV is not automatically available in the pixel shader; pass uv[0] through your own varying.
Write every declared color-buffer output in all branches because unwritten output values are undefined.
Use Render Select TOP to inspect extra buffers because the GLSL TOP output connector shows buffer 0.

templates.summary: A minimal GLSL MAT vertex/pixel pair. Assign vertex code to `vdat`, pixel code to `pdat`, and declare Color on the Attributes page if using TDAttrib_Color().
required_setup: Assign a vertex shader DAT to GLSL MAT `vdat`.
Assign a pixel shader DAT to GLSL MAT `pdat`.
Declare custom or POP attributes on the GLSL MAT Attributes page before calling TDAttrib_<Name>().
gotchas: Compile errors show as a blue/red checkerboard material; inspect Errors or Info output for compiler details.
POP-compatible shader attributes must be declared on the Attributes page and accessed as TDAttrib_<Name>().
Use TDWorldToProj(TDDeform(TDPos())) as the default vertex transform unless the material intentionally overrides deformation.

templates.summary: A GLSL MAT vertex/pixel pair for World-space lighting, normals, Order Independent Transparency, fog, dithering, and rarely changing specialization modes.
required_setup: Assign vertex and pixel shader DATs to GLSL MAT `vdat` and `pdat`.
Use a Render TOP with a Camera COMP and Light COMP entries when lighting should be scene driven.
Use the Constants page for rarely changing specialization modes, not per-frame animation.
gotchas: TDDeformNorm(TDNormal()) returns a World-space normal; keep lighting vectors in the same space.
Call TDCheckOrderIndTrans near the start of the pixel shader when Order Independent Transparency should work.
Specialization constants cache shader variants and are best for modes that change rarely.

templates.summary: A GLSL MAT vertex/pixel pair for instance texture selection and Render Pick DAT/CHOP guarded output.
required_setup: Enable instancing on the Geometry COMP Instance page.
Configure instance textures on the Geometry COMP or GLSL MAT workflow before sampling TDInstanceTexture().
Use Render Pick DAT or Render Pick CHOP when TD_PICKING_ACTIVE paths need to be exercised.
gotchas: Pass instance ids and texture indices through flat varyings so integer values are not interpolated.
TDInstanceTextureIndex() is commonly collected in the vertex shader, then TDInstanceTexture() samples in the pixel shader.
Call TDWritePickingValues() before overriding vTDPickVert or vTDCustomPickVert fields for custom Render Pick output.

templates.summary: A minimal GLSL POP compute shader for modifying a selected attribute class without changing element counts.
required_setup: Assign this DAT to GLSL POP `computedat`.
Set Attribute Class to Point when writing P.
Add P to Output Attributes so P[id] is allocated and writable.
gotchas: GLSL POP works on one attribute class at a time and does not change point, vertex, or primitive counts.
Always guard writes with TDIndex() and TDNumElements() because the actual dispatch may be rounded up to the workgroup size.
Use GLSL Advanced POP when the shader must write multiple classes, index buffers, or new output counts.

templates.summary: A minimal GLSL Advanced POP compute shader for copying point positions into the advanced point output namespace.
required_setup: Assign this DAT to GLSL Advanced POP `computedat`.
Set Number of Threads to an input or max output mode that matches the intended output.
Add P to Point Output Attributes or keep wildcard output attributes enabled.
Use Topology POP when multiple advanced passes need combined topology.
gotchas: GLSL Advanced POP can write point, vertex, primitive, index-buffer, and output-count data; keep the output contract explicit.
When changing output counts, do not assume every input attribute still has a corresponding output element.
Per primitive batch dispatch is useful when all primitives in the current batch share a type.

common_gotchas: Do not add #version statements to TouchDesigner shader DATs; the operator inserts them.
Use Info DAT, Info CHOP, or operator errors to distinguish shader compile failures from intentionally black output.
For GLSL TOP compute shaders, use TDImageStoreOutput()/TDImageLoadOutput() for output textures; TDOutputSwizzle is handled internally by those helpers.
For GLSL POP and GLSL Advanced POP, guard compute writes with TDIndex() and TDNumElements() before writing SSBO-backed attributes.
